raw_response: BNY Mellon described its ETF servicing business as experiencing "above-market growth" throughout 2023, noting strong net inflows that capped the year. In 2024, the company highlighted particular strength in this area, with ETF Assets Under Custody and Administration (AUC/A) reaching $2.8 trillion by Q4, up over 60% year-over-year. The firm stated that inflows into its platform continued to outpace the market, validating multiyear investments made into these platforms.
